tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: List the published taufnaus shops (slug, name, number of products). Use a slug to restrict search_products to one shop.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products across all taufnaus shops (or one shop). Understands meaning: describe the wish in natural language, e.g. 'Taufgeschenk für ein Mädchen, etwas Bleibendes, bis 40 Euro'. Returns product_id, shop, name, price (EUR incl. VAT), availability, image and url.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one product: description, images, attributes, pack sizes (variant_id, price, available quantity) and the maximum orderable quantity.

tools.name: find_related_products
tools.description: Similar products, products bought together and products with the same attributes.

tools.name: set_cart
tools.description: Create or replace the cart. Pass cart_id to change an existing cart (omit it to create one). items replace the whole cart; quantity 0 removes an item. All items must come from the same shop. For products with pack sizes pass variant_id from get_product. Quantities above stock are rejected with a mes

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Show the cart with current prices and availability.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Create the order for a cart and return a payment_url (Stripe). The customer opens it, enters the delivery address and pays there (card, 3-D Secure). Nothing is charged before the customer confirms on that page. Ask the customer for their e-mail address first.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order created with checkout (waiting for payment, paid, shipped with tracking number).
